== Photo identification ==

[[:File:Cindy Thornburg.jpg]] is the profile photo of a public profile named "Cindy Thornburg" with the username "decipherpres" ([https://web.archive.org/web/20261027202320/https://www.pinterest.com/decipherpres/ preserved copy, 27 October 2026]). Under the Small World Rule we take it to be her: the name is uncommon, and the username reads as "Decipher president", the post she has held at Decipher (ICv2, 25 August 2009: "Cindy Thornburg (Decipher's President)"; [https://web.archive.org/web/20251203200542/https://icv2.com/articles/games/view/15699/warren-holland-speaks-out preserved copy]). The profile itself does not mention Decipher in its text. [[User:Comlink Cursor|Comlink Cursor]] ([[User talk:Comlink Cursor|talk]]) 20:25, 27 October 2026 (UTC)
